jobs.occupation: AI Red Team Specialist – Lead Researcher in Agentic Security
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced red teamer with proven credentials in agentic red teaming to join our advanced product and research team.

What You’ll Do

You’ll join the team dedicated to building and developing a tool that dynamically tests and evaluates large language models (LLMs) and their native application context for vulnerabilities.

You’ll be working with seasoned reverse engineers, application pentesters, red teamers, and data scientists, bridging multiple digital disciplines by creating a unique suite that gives our clients the capability to test, remediate, and harden their agentic workloads.

What You’ll Bring

Most of all, we value ingenuity, curiosity, and drive. You may be a great fit for this role if you have experience with:

• Building or contributing to tools used for dynamic application testing

• Working extensively with open source or proprietary tools used for web and application pentesting

• Actively adopting LLMs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) in automating and enhancing your penetration tests

• Spending time researching agentic vulnerabilities and attending relevant trainings or conferences

To Fit Right In Here At The Tech Collective

• You should be genuinely curious about new developments within the red teaming domain

• You possess the willingness to tackle new and technical challenges as they arise

• You know how to break down and structure complex assignments and enjoy sharing your knowledge and insights with your team members

• You possess a startup mentality to help drive the innovation and ingenuity of our red team products

• You can cooperate seamlessly with different profiles in a highly diverse team of researchers, developers, consultants, and red teamers

We don’t expect you to know everything – after all, agentic security is a rapidly evolving field! In this role, we’re looking for someone who wants to own, develop, and innovate the product modules related to testing the application context (e.g., API security, cryptographic implementation, broken authentication, RBAC) and supporting infrastructure (e.g., misconfigurations, server-side vulnerabilities) for the agents that we test.

To succeed in this role, your experience and competencies should include:

Professional experience

• A minimum of five years’ progressive experience in enterprise red teaming or offensive research

• A proven track record of web application pentesting with an emphasis on remediation and hardening

• Experience defining and driving product roadmaps for red team tools (not required, but highly valued)

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex technology stacks, including common cloud platforms (M365/Azure, Google, or AWS), CI/CD pipelines, and AI-powered platforms and systems

• Experience communicating technical findings to non-technical stakeholders and the ability to bring technical assessments to life

Technical competencies

• Familiarity with both Mitre and OWASP frameworks, and experience applying them in client reporting

• Relevant security certifications (e.g., OSCP, OSCE, OSEP, GIAC GPEN/GXPN, etc.) are a plus, indicating solid foundational knowledge and commitment to the offensive security field.

• Prior experience developing agent-specific attack types such as prompt injection, memory & context poisoning, or jailbreaking

• A working understanding of MCP, LLM pipelines, the functional aspects of LLMs, and how modern agent solutions are integrated with widely used cloud suites such as M365 or AWS

Finally, experience in intermediate to advanced vulnerability research related to applications or operating systems will be considered a strong plus, but is not a requirement for this role.

What we offer

On top of a competitive salary and bonus package, we offer you the opportunity to join a unique team of experts and enthusiasts in your field. Our expectations are matched by our willingness to invest in your development – whether through training, conferences, or the opportunity to pursue research in areas you’re passionate about.

We combine remote work with meaningful co-working at our offices in Copenhagen and will provide you with the tooling and hardware required to reach our goal of building a unique red team platform.

For questions or enquiries, feel free to contact Anders Rømer Skøtt at anrs@thetechcollective.eu // +45 31717487.

Department: Business Ethics Compliance Office

Location: Bagsværd, Denmark

Do you want to help shape global ethics and compliance in one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies? Would you like to use your legal and/or compliance expertise and pharmaceutical industry experience to help our organisation make the right decisions? Join Novo as a Senior Compliance Counsel in the Ethics & Compliance (E&C) Strategic Operations and Advice team.

Anchored within the Business Ethics Compliance Office (BECO), this role offers the opportunity to provide practical advice, strengthen global compliance processes and help turn our ethics and compliance strategy into action

**What You’ll Bring

**You bring strong ethics and compliance, legal or adjacent experience from a complex multinational environment, combined with the judgement to turn regulatory requirements into practical advice. You are comfortable building relationships across functions and communicating complex topics clearly.

• A degree in Law, Business or similar

• A strong professional track record from an Ethics & Compliance or Legal function

• Experience identifying, assessing and mitigating ethics and compliance risks

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to provide clear and practical guidance

• Fluency in written and spoken English

• Experience working in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotechnology sectors or FMCG, either directly or through a relevant consultancy or law firm

**What You’ll Do

**As a Senior Compliance Counsel, you will act as an expert and trusted adviser on global Ethics & Compliance (E&C) matters. Reporting to the Director of Strategic Operations and Advice, you will work with colleagues across our global Legal, Ethics & Compliance organisation and the business to identify risks and develop practical, compliant solutions. Your responsibilities will include:

• Provide day-to-day guidance and training on ethics and compliance matters, including anti-bribery and anti-corruption policies and procedures, helping colleagues translate requirements into practical decisions.

• Identify and assess compliance risks and develop proportionate mitigation approaches that support effective implementation globally and at headquarters.

• Develop and implement global processes, tools and best-practice guidance across key ethics and compliance risk areas, making complex requirements easier to understand and apply.

• Contribute to the development and implementation of our global ethics and compliance strategy and programme, including leading or supporting strategic projects and following progress through to delivery.

• Build trusted relationships across the business, Legal and Group Internal Audit, while monitoring emerging ethics and compliance risks and contributing to relevant industry association working groups.

• Support the Business Ethics Committee by managing the secretariat, preparing meetings and materials, documenting decisions and coordinating follow-up on global compliance programme activities.

**Who You’ll Work With

**The Business Ethics Compliance Office (BECO) develops and leads the implementation of Novo’s global ethics & compliance strategy and programme, which focuses on the prevention of fraud, bribery, and off-label promotion. BECO is also responsible for Novo’s global systems and processes related to tracking payments to healthcare professionals, as well as compliance with data protection and AI regulations and respect for human rights.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have the opportunity to apply your expertise to compliance questions with global reach while working closely with colleagues across functions and geographies.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to use your legal and compliance expertise to strengthen global ethics and compliance at Novo Nordisk, apply for the Senior Compliance Counsel role based in Bagsværd, Denmark by 8 November 2026.

You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences in your CV about why you are applying. To support an efficient and fair recruitment process, please refrain from adding a photo to your CV.

We are an equal opportunities employer and are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all applicants.

**Factbird helps manufacturers turn real-time production data into decisions they can actually act on. Since 2016, we've helped manufacturers in 28 countries cut waste, boost uptime, and run smarter — from the shop floor to the boardroom. Over 300 companies trust us to make sense of their operations, and we're a team of 80+ people across Copenhagen and the US who care about making complex things simple.

We're growing our engineering team and hiring several Full Stack Cloud Engineers — people who can move confidently across our stack: React on the front end, Rust and Node.js on the back end, and a multi-account AWS underneath it all.

**About the Role

**We're open on where your strengths sit. Some of these roles will lean more toward the back end — APIs, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure. What matters is that you're genuinely full stack: comfortable owning a feature end to end, and willing to work across the stack when the team needs it. **

**

Team & growth**

**

• Solid, hands-on experience across the full stack — frontend (React or equivalent) and backend (Rust/Node.js, or equivalent) — even if you have a natural preference for one side

• A track record of shipping features independently, with a good instinct for testing, code quality, and clean design

As a Backend Engineer on this team, you'll be building and shipping features as part of a cross-functional product team with a direct commercial mission — not executing on a spec handed down to you, but helping shape what gets built and why.

This is a product engineering role. The team owns the problem, not just the delivery. You'll work closely with engineering leadership — not as a follower, but as a collaborator who contributes to the plan. What you'll do

• Good engineering habits. You can read an unfamiliar codebase, spot its strengths and weak spots, and improve it over time without needing a perfect plan first. You think about reliability and data, and you're realistic about making change in a production environment.

• Practical use of AI tools. Every engineer here uses Claude in daily work. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to make it part of how you work.

Bonus points

None of these are hard requirements.

• Java, Spring Boot, JUnit, RabbitMQ or MySQL specifically

• Kubernetes, Argo, GitHub Actions, Grafana or Loki

• Running services in Azure or another cloud, including tuning resources and cost

• Experience with fintech, payments, subscriptions or regulated data

Why join us

• Visible impact. You're joining a team with a full pipeline, and your work will show results quickly.

• A company serious about engineering quality. We're actively investing in elevating engineering practices across the organisation. You'll be part of that, not just a passenger.

• Solid company. Independent, profitable, growing. No VC pressure, no bloated roadmap. Just a clear mission and a team that cares.

• Good people. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. The culture is professional, informal, and genuinely collaborative.

• Room to grow. The scope of the work and the team's ambitions mean there's real room to step up.

Practical details

Location: Copenhagen. We're an office-first company, and it's a deliberate choice. We're moving fast, we have big ambitions, and we genuinely believe that being physically together is one of the things that makes that possible. Things move quicker when you can turn your chair and talk to someone.

The office is a five-minute walk from Rådhuspladsen and stocked with everything from fruit to fizzy drinks to afternoon snacks. Lunch is at Claus Meyer's canteen just across the street — proper food, not an afterthought. If you're putting in a long day, dinner is covered too.

Start: As soon as possible.

Salary: Competitive and based on your experience.

Reporting to: Engineering Manager.

• Technical interview: build something together with a Backend Engineer and the Engineering Manager (60 min) — onsite

• Culture conversation with the Engineering Manager and CTO (60 min) — onsite

• Meet the CEO (30 min) — onsite

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Learning-Based Multi-Agent Control under Uncertainty
jobs.description:
The Department of Electronic Systems at the Technical Faculty of IT and Design invites applications for a postdoc in learning-based multi-agent control under uncertainty, with applications to autonomous multi-robot systems operating in dynamic and uncertain environments, as per February 1, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is available for a period of 2 years.

Your work tasks   The position focuses on fundamental research in learning-based planning and control of interacting autonomous agents under uncertainty. You will develop new theoretical and algorithmic approaches for distributed and cooperative control, combining learning or online adaptation with principled treatment of safety, robustness, and performance. Research challenges include uncertain dynamics and disturbances, partial or noisy information, changing interactions between agents, and limited or unreliable communication.

A central part of the work will be to formulate rigorous methods and establish their properties, for example concerning stability, safety, constraint satisfaction, robustness, and convergence, where applicable. Depending on the research direction, the work may draw on learning-augmented model predictive control, safe reinforcement learning, data-driven modelling and safety mechanism (e.g. CBF), distributed optimization, or robust and adaptive control. You will develop reproducible numerical studies and simulations to examine the strengths, limitations, and scalability of the proposed methods.

The research will be carried out in the Horizon Europe ROX-6G project, where heterogeneous robot teams provide a compelling application for coordination under uncertain conditions and connectivity constraints. Although the position is primarily theoretical, you will collaborate with colleagues working on robotic implementation and will contribute to experimental validation. You will lead and co-author publications in international journals and conferences, engage with project partners, contribute to research planning and scientific discussions, and support knowledge exchange within the team.

Your competencies

We seek a researcher with a PhD in control engineering, robotics, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, or a closely related field, and a strong background in mathematical modelling, control, optimization, or multi-agent systems.

You should be able to formulate original research problems, develop and analyse rigorous methods, and demonstrate research quality through peer-reviewed scientific publications. Experience in learning-based control, robust or nonlinear control, distributed control, or decision-making under uncertainty is particularly relevant; expertise in every one of these areas is not expected.

You should have good scientific programming skills, for example in Python, MATLAB, or C++, and be able to evaluate algorithms systematically through simulation. We value independent research initiative, clear scientific writing, and the ability to work constructively with researchers from different disciplines and backgrounds. Experience with autonomous robots, ROS/ROS 2, multi-robot simulation, or physical robotic experiments will be considered an advantage, but is not a prerequisite for this primarily theory-oriented position. Excellent written and spoken English is required.

Who we are

In electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 600 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model. The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide. You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

The position is hosted in the Automation and Control Section, within a collaborative robotics research environment combining fundamental research with real-world applications.

In addition, you will work with an international team and research partners in ROX-6G, a European collaboration addressing autonomous robotic operations in demanding underground environments. Our research interests span safe and resilient decision-making, learning-enabled control, distributed multi-robot coordination, and validation in simulation and on robotic platforms. We encourage scientific independence, close exchange of ideas, and publication of high-quality research. More information: www.es.aau.dk.

Qualification requirements Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

jobs.description:
The National Center of Excellence PREDICT at Aalborg University in Copenhagen is looking to recruit a motivated and dedicated biostatistician with an interest in the technical part of research to join our international and interdisciplinary group of researchers in a double role as biostatistician and technical contact person. The position is for 3 years, full-time (37 hours per week) and is open for appointment from March 1st 2027.

Your work tasks

As biostatistician in PREDICT you will be involved in epidemiological studies of risk factors for IBD, pre-clinical disease development and treatment of IBD. You will join an active group of dedicated biostatisticians and data scientists ensuring knowledge sharing and continuous professional development.

You will contribute to study planning, take responsibility for data management and statistical analyses of nationwide register data and large datasets collected in PREDICT, and contribute to the interpretation and reporting of the results, including co-authoring of scientific papers.

In addition to the biostatistical task, the position also includes the role of the primary technical contact person on our data infrastructure hosted on the National Genom Center’s HPC system. You will coordinate technical support, manage user access and onboarding, and assist researchers with data management, troubleshooting, and computational workflows. The role also involves ensuring secure handling of research data and contributing to the development and optimization of technical workflows.

Your competencies

Ideally, you have the following qualifications:

•    A master’s degree in statistics or equivalent

•    Experience conducting statistical analyses in epidemiological research

•    Knowledge about time-to-event analysis and related statistical methods.

•    Strong programming skills in R and/or Python

•    Experience in working with Linux-based computing environments

•    Experience working on High Performance Computing (HPC) systems

•    Experience with shell scripting for workflow automation and troubleshooting

•    Strong problem-solving skills and ability to support colleagues with technical challenges

•    Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Note that you must be qualified for both parts of the position to be taken into consideration.

Who we are

PREDICT was founded in 2021 and is at the forefront of international research to unravel the cause and prognosis of inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD), which are chronic and disabling conditions affecting millions of people worldwide. The Center is composed of biologists, clinicians, epidemiologists, and data scientists working with collaborators nationally and internationally to push the boundaries of precision medicine research and create real-world impact in IBD. We have state-of-the-art facilities within the center and this means through PREDICT you will be part of a well-funded research environment equipped with the latest technologies, unique data, and a world-leading network of collaborators.

PREDICT has grown to become a world-renowned center, organized as a broad, national and interdisciplinary collaboration between Aalborg University and Aalborg University Hospital, with a multidisciplinary team of immunologists, geneticists, data scientists, clinicians and many more disciplines. PREDICT also has strong international collaborations across the world.

Are you passionate about shaping a more sustainable future and would you like to play a key role in Vattenfall’s transition to cleaner energy? Do you want to help drive the development, construction, and operation of our offshore wind portfolio? Vattenfall is looking for a Senior Consent Manager to strengthen its Offshore Consenting team in Denmark.

The Offshore Consenting team is an international team with representation in all Vattenfall’s key markets. We are involved throughout the offshore wind value chain, from pre-tender, through the tendering phase, project delivery, and throughout the operational phase. We are responsible for securing permits for Vattenfall’s offshore wind portfolio, and for enabling permit compliance during project delivery and operations.

In Denmark, Vattenfall and its partners are operating 5 offshore wind farms, including the Vesterhav Nord and Syd projects that were fully commissioned in 2024. Beyond our current portfolio, we have been awarded the two new Danish projects Hesselø and North Sea Central both including an onshore and offshore scope.

What will you do?

As Senior Consent Manager, you will play a pivotal role in enabling our offshore wind projects in Denmark. You will act as a coordinator and problem solver within the organization, working together with different teams and disciplines. In addition, you will be a key contact person externally towards authorities. For this position we are looking for a candidate with a strong profile within onshore permitting and environmental conditions, e.g., experience from onshore grid infrastructure projects in Denmark.

Consenting Strategy

• Analyse Consenting requirements, risks, and opportunities to support project execution

• Deliver and implement a Consenting Strategy in development and construction of the projects in collaboration with the offshore scope.

Obtain Consent

• Understand, anticipate and communicate which permits, laws and regulations are applicable to our projects;

• Ensure timely application for and receipt of permits, licenses and dispensations

Enable Consent Compliance

• Actively track and manage our permit requirements and commitments;

• Work with project teams and packages to enable full permit compliance of their respective scopes;

• Engage with and report to both local and state authorities.

Steer Consent

• Monitor and anticipate regulatory developments with a potential impact on our permits.

• Contribute to regulatory developments directly through consultations, or via our industry associations or interest groups.

Location

Copenhagen or Kolding.

Qualifications

You have an analytical mindset coupled with strong project management, communication- and interpersonal skills. You can structure and process complex information and discern implications for our business and can communicate clearly with various stakeholders and secure quality and timelines in projects.

You have experience working in international and multidisciplinary teams and thrive in a dynamic environment, skillfully managing multiple tasks under tight deadlines. Your excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills allow you to build and maintain positive relationships across diverse teams. You can work well independently and in collaboration with others and have the dedication to see a task through despite challenges. Above all, you consistently prioritize health and safety in all aspects of your work.

You can have fun whilst being serious and are serious about having fun.

Next to this you bring:

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in the fields of biology, environmental science, spatial planning, or another relevant field;

• Knowledge of onshore environmental and spatial planning regulations;

• Ideally you have +5 years of relevant experience. Alternatively, you have gained (permit management) experience in other renewable energy, or other large infrastructure-, industrial-, or construction projects;

• Excellent oral and written communication skills in Danish (native or near native) and English (full working proficiency).
